One of the biggest problems with printing PLA parts is the finish. What I found works best, without using any dangerous chemicals, is water sanding. Just in around 10 minutes of water sanding the printed object with P120 to P1200 grit sandpaper you'll get the smoothest finish. Next spray it with Filler Primer, wait for it to dry, sand again with fine grit paper until smooth and spray it with paint. After the paint has dried you can apply some texture spray.
